subject: Life Skills
title: The Junk Drawer System
description: Learn The Junk Drawer System in one minute.

hook.text: Every home has a junk drawer. Studies show it's the most opened drawer in the average kitchen.

buildup.text: Without dividers, the junk drawer becomes a black hole. Items enter and are never seen again.

discovery.text: Small trays or dividers turn chaos into categories: tools, batteries, tape, pens, and miscellaneous.

twist.text: The real fix isn't organizing the drawer. It's reducing what goes into it in the first place.

climax.text: Empty it fully, discard expired and broken items, then divide the survivors into clear zones.

punchline.text: A junk drawer with zones isn't junk anymore.

quiz.question: What is the first step to fixing a junk drawer?
options: Empty it completely and discard useless items
Label the outside of the drawer
